hints.tr: Var olan bir tabloya kural eklemek: `ALTER TABLE tablo ADD CONSTRAINT ad ...`.
hints.en: Adding a rule to an existing table: `ALTER TABLE table ADD CONSTRAINT name ...`.

hints.tr: Bağın kalıbı: `FOREIGN KEY (çocuk_sütun) REFERENCES ebeveyn_tablo(anahtar)`. Kontrol, bağ kurulduktan sonra 1006 siparişini silmeyi deniyor — sunucunun bunu reddetmesi gerekiyor.
hints.en: The shape of a link: `FOREIGN KEY (child_column) REFERENCES parent_table(key)`. After the link is in place the check tries to delete order 1006 — the server has to refuse.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
ALTER TABLE order_items
ADD CONSTRAINT fk_items_order
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
ALTER TABLE order_items
ADD CONSTRAINT fk_items_order
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id);
```

checks.query: SELECT k.COLUMN_NAME, p.TABLE_NAME AS parent_table FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS r JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = r.CONSTRAINT_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS p ON p.CONSTRAINT_NAME = r.UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE k.TABLE_NAME = 'order_items' ORDER BY k.COLUMN_NAME;
SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = 1006; SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
